title: FM27 Wonderkids — First Preview Shortlist & Scouting Checks
description: FM27 wonderkids to scout in the Launch Preview: Max Dowman, Rio Ngumoha and Rui Araki, with dated sources, positions and save-specific checks.
meta: Updated 30 October 2026 · Launch Preview · First sourced candidates, not a tested ranking.
body:
The FM27 Launch Preview is playable, and the first FM27 wonderkid lists are now available. Start with Max Dowman, Rio Ngumoha and Rui Araki as scouting candidates, then check whether their cost, availability and development needs fit your save.

The table below uses FM Scout’s 29 October 2026 Revision 1, which the author describes as a quick draft. Ages follow its in-game reference date of 13 July 2026. We checked the source on 30 October; these are published database references, not our own in-game tests. The source does not state a numeric game patch.

First FM27 wonderkids to scout

Max Dowman16ArsenalAMRC — attacking midfield, right/centreTransfer eligibility, compensation and an available development pathway. His inclusion does not establish an affordable transfer fee.
Rio Ngumoha17LiverpoolAMRL — attacking midfield, right/leftAvailability and playing time on the flank you actually need; scout both role suitability and asking terms.
Rui Araki18Gamba OsakaGK — goalkeeperLeague registration, work-permit eligibility and the fee quoted in your save. See the bargain candidates for a separate published cost estimate.

All three appear in the FM27 list, rather than a relabelled FM26 shortlist. Araki’s age, position and club also match his sortitoutsi FM27 profile. A player appearing here is a reason to scout, not evidence that every club can sign him.

How to use the shortlist in your save

  1. Check the edition and database. Use FM27 and record the game version, database selection and any transfer update. A Preview save and a later patched save may differ.
  2. Search by name and club. If a player is missing, check your loaded leagues and database size before concluding that the source is wrong.
  3. Scout for your own squad. Read the scout’s judgement of current quality and potential alongside your existing players. A star rating is relative to that club.
  4. Ask for the full terms. Fee, wages, signing bonus, agent fee and promises all matter. A young player on an elite club’s books is not automatically a bargain.
  5. Choose a playing-time route. Check your depth chart and available loan options before buying a player whose development requires minutes you cannot offer.

Potential Ability and scout stars are different

Current Ability (CA) and Potential Ability (PA) are database concepts. Scout stars are an assessment relative to your squad; they are not a direct reading of a hidden PA number. Some players have a potential range, so different new saves can produce different outcomes.

FM Scout also uses its own recommendation score. That score is the author’s judgement, not an official FM27 rating. This page does not convert those scores or scout stars into an exact PA, and does not rank three players at different positions as if they were interchangeable.

What remains provisional in the Preview

Sports Interactive’s Launch Preview announcement warns that some data and club or player assets remain subject to rights-holder approval. FM Scout says its first-revision ratings are still being refined; sortitoutsi also warns that its early FM27 guides may be inaccurate. Recheck a candidate in your own build before committing your budget.

Source-read date: 30 October 2026. Fees, wages, negotiated availability and long-term development have not been tested in-game by this site. We will not present an estimated price or potential range as a guaranteed result.
